items.title: An immersion with reduced source factors as an open immersion followed by a closed immersion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that an immersion with reduced source factors as an open immersion followed by the closed immersion given by the reduced closure of its image (statement lines 279-285). The counted proof is short and complete: it factors through the reduced closure, uses the description of an immersion as factoring through a closed immersion into an open subscheme, and concludes by comparing two reduced closed subschemes with the same underlying set via uniqueness, which identifies the first factor as an isomorphism onto its image (proof lines 288-303). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the reduced induced structure and the uniqueness of reduced closed subschemes.
